newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GPG makes full bid for Ballarat.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GPG makes full bid for Ballarat.

text.p: Guinness Peat Group Plc said on Friday it would make a full takeover bid at A$2.45 per share for tourism and leisure group Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd.

GPG said its offer would include the final dividend payment of four cents per share. The latest bid values Ballarat Brewing at A$66.4 million and follows a proportional bid pitched at the same price which met with little success.
GPG had unsuccessfully sought permission from the Australian Securities Commission for an exemption to have its partial bid changed to a full bid.
Foster's Brewing Group Ltd is the largest shareholder in Ballarat Brewing with a 33 percent stake and said during the earlier bid that it would consider its options.
